prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your specific needs (size of organization, B2B vs B2C, patient acquisition vs branding, budget, compliance needs, etc.). I can help you find the best match. Below are practical steps, evaluation criteria, and next steps so you can quickly narrow to the right agency.

How to find the best agency for you
- Define your goals and scope: patient acquisition, physician/recruitment marketing, branding, digital transformation, PR, medical device/B2B sales, regulatory communications, telehealth growth, etc.
- Set budget and timeline: will you run a long-term retainer, project-based work, or performance-based campaigns?
- Identify must-haves: HIPAA experience, Medicare/Medicaid experience, EMR integrations, multi-site campaign experience, Spanish-language outreach, etc.

Where to look for candidates
- Directories and review sites: Clutch, UpCity, Agency Spotter, Google My Business (reviews).
- Industry awards and trade press: Healthcare Advertising Awards, Ad Age, local PRSA or business journals.
- Referrals: ask peers at hospital systems, clinics, or health-tech companies.
- LinkedIn: search for St. Louis-based agencies with healthcare case studies.

Key questions to ask prospects
- Have you worked with organizations like ours (size, specialty, B2B vs B2C)? Can you share case studies and measurable results?
- How do you handle HIPAA and patient-data security/compliance?
- What channels and tactics do you recommend and why? (SEO, PPC, social, content, email, referral networks)
- What are your reporting metrics and cadence? How do you demonstrate ROI?
- Who will be our day-to-day contacts and what does your team look like?
- Can you provide client references?

Criteria to evaluate and compare agencies
- Proven healthcare experience and relevant case studies
- Measurable results (cost-per-lead, conversion rates, lifetime value, CAC)
- Compliance and data security practices
- Transparent pricing and clear deliverables
- Cultural fit and communication style
- Technical capabilities (analytics, CRM/EMR integrations, ad tech)

If you want, I can:
- Search and shortlist 4–6 St. Louis agencies with strong healthcare experience and provide a direct comparison,
- Or recommend agency questions and an RFP template you can send.

Tell me: What kind of healthcare organization are you (hospital, clinic, med device, healthtech startup)? What's your primary goal and ballpark budget? I’ll tailor a shortlist.
